d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic Kitchen professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests.

As a Commis I – Pastry Kitchen, you are responsible for assisting in the daily pastry and bakery preparation, ensuring that all desserts, pastries and baked goods are prepared according to the hotel's standards and quality expectations.
q: You should have a professional kitchen apprenticeship, culinary training or a relevant pastry and bakery course, with previous experience in a quality hotel or food and beverage establishment being an advantage.

Basic knowledge of pastry and bakery preparation techniques, including desserts, cakes, creams, doughs and other pastry products, is preferred. The ability to communicate in English, along with a good understanding of food preparation, presentation, storage and preservation standards, is essential.

The ideal candidate will be passionate about pastry and baking, with a positive attitude and a willingness to learn and develop new skills. You should be committed to working closely with the kitchen and service teams to deliver exceptional quality and memorable guest experiences.
You are a positive, dynamic, creative and dedicated team player with the ability to work in a multicultural environment and under pressure, while possessing the following additional competencies:
r: li
Support the Chef de Partie or Demi Chef de Partie in the daily operation of the Pastry Kitchen.
li
Prepare and produce desserts, pastries, cakes, bakery items and other sweet products according to the menu specifications.
li
Ensure all pastry preparations are carried out according to the recipes, standards and instructions provided by the Chef de Partie.
li
Maintain the work area, equipment and utensils in clean and hygienic conditions, following the hotel's food safety and hygiene standards.
li
Assist in preparing the daily mise en place and ensure all ingredients are properly prepared and available for service.

Ensure proper handling, storage and rotation of pastry ingredients and products to maintain freshness and quality.
li
Follow instructions and recommendations from immediate superiors to complete daily tasks efficiently.
li
Ensure consistent quality, presentation and portion control of all pastry products.
li
Keep up-to-date with new pastry products, recipes, preparation methods and techniques.
li
Coordinate with other kitchen sections to ensure smooth operations, timely food preparation, cleanliness, wastage control and cost efficiency.

About Mantis Collection: Mantis is a boutique hospitality group that was founded by conservationist Adrian Gardiner in 2000, with its main focus predominantly in Africa and the Middle East. Mantis grew from Adrian’s vision to restore and rewild degraded farmland which he developed into a widely-acclaimed Private Game Reserve. This was the first private game reserve in the Eastern Cape and the beginning of eco-tourism in a poverty-stricken province that had few opportunities outside of commercial farming. Adrian and the Mantis team successfully created a place where man and nature could co-exist sustainably. From this initial success, the Mantis model was then developed worldwide, understanding that consumers could use the Mantis portfolio as a mark of quality, consistency and character. Today the diverse portfolio of handpicked properties links up to create travel journeys, which offer guests the opportunity to experience the essence of the location in a setting of tailored luxury. Rooted in conservation, Mantis pursues sustainable business practices and develops tourism products that are respectful of the environment and communities in which they operate.

d: Responsible and accountable for the assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of specialized care to a specific patient population. Involves in research and staff education and development.

Complex ostomy pouching and management of difficult pouching situations.
Complex preoperative stoma-site assessment and marking.
Limb salvage and management of complex diabetic/ischemic wounds.
Assessment and management of atypical and complex wounds.
Clinical and evidence-based evaluation of wound and ostomy products.
Education Required: Master’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing.
Years of Experience Required: Four (4) years of nursing experience with Master’s, or six (6) years of with Bachelor’s Degree.
Preferably holding specialty certification covering (wound care and ostomy) such as
Wound, Ostomy and Continence Nursing Certification Board (WOCNCB).
National Alliance of Wound Care and Ostomy (NAWCO).
